what: One live check of the fallback to Muse Spark (agent/src/core/llm.js, LLM_FALLBACK=on): the model server was made unreachable (a closed port), so each call went once to the Meta Model API. Run on the GPU server, 2026-10-29.
note: Two calls only, to confirm the protocol (reasoning_effort low, tool call ids) works against the real API; no other Meta Model API calls were made for it.
